title: Smooth a bigram model and rescore transcripts
brief: Build an interpolated Kneser-Ney bigram model, measure its perplexity, and use it to rescore the n-best list of a recognizer.
hints: zip(padded[:-1], padded[1:]) lists the bigrams of one padded sentence; Counter.update adds them all.
A Counter's keys are the distinct bigram types, so len(counts) is the denominator of P_cont and a count over keys gives N1+.
In kn_prob, C(history) is the sum of counts over the bigrams whose first element is history, which includes (history, '</s>').
perplexity sums math.log2 of each predicted token's probability, then returns 2 ** (-sum / n). Count '</s>', not '<s>'.
rescore adds the acoustic score, lm_weight times the natural-log LM score of the padded sentence, and insertion_penalty per word.
